description: Onchain Answer Engine: ask a plain-English question about any wallet or token across the 23 EVM chains and get back a CITED verdict in one call — 'is token 0x… on <chain> a scam?', 'what does wallet 0x… hold?'. NodeFlare plans the on-chain lookups, runs them on its own nodes, and synthesizes a sourced answer. Paid: needs NODEFLARE_API_KEY or X402_PRIVATE_KEY (no free anonymous tier — it runs on a GPU).

question.description: Natural-language question about a wallet or token, e.g. 'Is token 0xdAC17…ec7 on eth a scam?'

name: onchain_answer
